cost_limits: Instrumented timings contain tracing and snapshot overhead. Prefix event counts are not equal CPU weights. Copy samples and original full prediction times are diagnostic under concurrent host work, not an optimized benchmark or complete-request timing.

proposal.pause: Before heap pop at return_decision, then before later_decision. Preserve pending tuple and same-timestamp ordering.
proposal.clone: One deepcopy of entire dynamic object graph, preserving request aliases; carry cumulative run count separately. No fieldwise copies or native forks.
proposal.static: Only independently proven read-only static data may be memo-shared, including frozen context potential; no mutable messages or calendars.
proposal.quiet_tail: Only when all remaining heap items are tick, every request terminal and future E recovery impossible; preserve exact existing tick count, last clock, horizon and event-budget behavior.
proposal.test_gate: All32/4 full result bytes against independent original runs; count constructor, snapshot, clone, output-copy and all preparation costs. Preserve18 historical unknowns.
